description: Use when working with the Vercel **REST API** and **@vercel/sdk** — the programmatic interface to the Vercel hosting platform at api.vercel.com. Covers bearer-token auth (VERCEL_TOKEN), team scoping (teamId/slug), per-endpoint versioning (/v1, /v8, /v9), pagination, errors/rate limits, and the typed @vercel/sdk TypeScript client. Bundles the complete machine-readable **OpenAPI spec** (every endpoint, param, and schema) plus the conceptual REST docs. Invoke for any REST endpoint shape/path/param lookup, request/response schema, @vercel/sdk usage, or 'how do I call the Vercel API'. For the `vercel` CLI, the MCP server, and platform concepts (deploy/domains/env/functions) use the sibling skill `working-with-vercel`. NOT for the Vercel AI SDK (`ai` package): use working-with-vercel-ai-sdk.
